_doc: Unicode scripts (the Unicode Script property; names of Go's unicode.Scripts). spaceless (generated): the scripts CLDR's scriptMetadata marks "LB letters" (major languages allow line breaks between letters: words are not separated by spaces), so a word count is meaningless (triage facts count characters) and search uses the substring (trigram) index. substring_extra (hand-kept decision): further scripts searched by substring although they use spaces — Hangul, whose words carry attached particles (견적서를 holds 견적서), and the matra-based Indic scripts (Devanagari, Bengali, Gurmukhi, Gujarati, Oriya, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Sinhala), whose dependent vowel signs unicode61 treats as separators (कि, की, कु, कू word-index to क; the substring index and its scan keep the sign).
_source: generated by scripts/update-unicode-data.sh from the pinned Unicode Character Database and CLDR (unicode-pin.json); edit only the hand-kept keys, then re-run the script
